verdict.rationale: MailerLite's own docs describe a Stripe connection for taking payments in bookings. They also claim no-code connections to 5,000+ apps, which suggests some first-party integration reach. Shopify, Segment/CDP and product-database integrations are not shown, and the shop-data import endpoints are only developer API building blocks, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented first-party Shopify integration, CDP/Segment connector, product-database sync, evidence the integrations are first-party and maintained, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect the platform to my existing stack — Stripe or Shopify, a CDP like Segment, my product database — with maintained first-party integrations

citations.quote: take payment through Stripe and trigger emails on booking
